description: Preview selected listing data on up to 25 EXISTING Amazon offers using Amazon VALIDATION_PREVIEW; no offer changes. Parts select photos, GPSR contacts, Amazon texts, safety documents, shipping settings, missing attributes, or the opt-in measurements refresh. Rows report status (ready, nothing, blocked, rejected, failed), attributes, issues, skipped, filled, stillMissing and untranslated. Measurement rows additionally show measurements (field key/title, before and after values with units) and measurementPreview. To send measurements, copy each ready product id and its measurementPreview into measurementPreviews on update_amazon_listing_content; a changed CRM or Amazon value requires a fresh preview. Missing measurements are not invented, ambiguous values are not replaced, and another store is preserved. Set missing Amazon answers with get_amazon_fields and set_amazon_field_values; edit catalog measurements on the product. Use inspect_amazon_listings to find existing offers, then update_amazon_listing_content to send ready rows. Needs a selected Amazon marketplace, but no write arming.

marketplaceId.description: One Amazon store by its id (APJ6JRA9NG5V4 is amazon.it, A1PA6795UKMFR9 is amazon.de). Omit for the main store; a send needs it when several stores are open for listing-data updates.

measurementPreviews.description: For parts including measurements, map each product id to the measurementPreview returned by preview_amazon_listing_content. Required for a real measurement update; a changed CRM or Amazon value requires another preview. Omit for other parts.

parts.description: What to send: images (main photo and up to 8 more), gpsr (manufacturer and EU responsible person), texts (Amazon title and bullet points), documents (safety PDFs), shipping (assigned shipping template and handling time), attributes (fill missing listing facts only), measurements (explicitly refresh changed item/package weight and dimensions from CRM facts and Amazon field answers). Default: the original six parts; measurements must be named explicitly. Missing, invalid or ambiguous measurements are never cleared or guessed. For measurement sends, pass measurementPreviews from the read-only preview. Package measurements are separate from the item and from the outer parcel used to buy a shipping label.

productIds.description: The products whose Amazon offers to update, at most 25 ids from search_products or inspect_amazon_listings.

items.description: A product id returned by search_products.
